259:t_1:83.en:
$$ロゼ$$
「That would be the so-called war with $$バアル$$, then.」

259:t_1:84.en:
$$葵$$
「$$ハーデス$$ of $$ミケーネ$$ went on pompously about some battle between gods and devils, too, didn't he.」

259:t_1:85.en:
$$タケル$$
「If the $$サイデリアル$$ really are seeking $$地球の次元力$$ for the fight against $$バアル$$...」

259:t_1:86.en:
$$タケル$$
「If they had asked Earthlings to cooperate as equals, that kind of fight might never have happened.」

259:t_1:87.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「To think that way about invaders... You're a romantic.」

259:t_1:88.en:
$$ノノ$$
「But it's wonderful. Building friendship across the stars.」

259:t_1:89.en:
$$タケル$$
「Maybe I can think like this because I'm not an Earthling.」

259:t_1:90.en:
$$ロゼ$$
「It doesn't matter what planet you were born on... I think that's the power of your kindness, $$マーズ$$.」

259:t_1:92.en:
$$チコ$$
「Yeah, yeah, thanks for the show.」

259:t_1:93.en:
$$朔哉$$
「In the end, everything gets steered onto this track, and I end up left out in the cold.」

259:t_1:94.en:
$$ノノ$$
「Don't be bitter, don't be bitter! Don't mind it, $$朔哉$$!」

259:t_1:95.en:
$$朔哉$$
「Thanks. Seeing how cheerful $$ノノ$$ is really lifts my spirits.」

259:t_1:96.en:
$$ジョニー$$
「You can't, $$朔哉$$. If you lay a hand on $$ノノ$$, $$ラルク$$ won't stay quiet.」

259:t_1:97.en:
$$ラルク$$
「I-I have nothing to do with it... If $$ノノ$$ says it's fine.」

259:t_1:98.en:
$$ノノ$$
「No way, Big Sis! You're going to offer $$ノノ$$ up as a sacrifice to $$朔哉$$!?」

259:t_1:99.en:
$$朔哉$$
「What the heck do you mean, sacrifice!?」

259:t_1:100.en:
$$ノノ$$
「You don't know? It means being forced to become the bride of someone you don't even like, due to various circumstances.」

259:t_1:101.en:
$$朔哉$$
「That's not what I'm trying to say!」

259:t_1:102.en:
$$くらら$$
「But just as there's friendship across the stars, I think love that crosses the line between human and android is fine too.」

259:t_1:103.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「Is that okay, $$くらら$$? If it reaches $$ＡＧ$$'s ears, a happy proposal will come your way.」

259:t_1:105.en:
$$タケル$$
「Enough joking around. Let's get ready for the hyperspace jump.」

259:t_1:106.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「Right. There are a lot of preparations to make, too.」

259:t_1:108.en:
$$くらら$$
「Do they mean sidling up to us, $$ニコラ$$?」

259:t_1:109.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「I heard it from $$ノリコ$$. That clothes go see-through during a hyperspace jump.」

259:t_1:110.en:
$$朔哉$$
「That 'dimensional wave something'... 'warp' for short... it has such a tasty feature built in!?」

259:t_1:111.en:
$$チコ$$
「$$朔哉$$~! What kind of guy are you...!」

259:t_1:112.en:
$$エイーダ$$
「You're an enemy of women!」

259:t_1:113.en:
$$朔哉$$
「W-wait! Isn't $$ニコラ$$ the one you should be angry at!」

259:t_1:114.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「Of course, I said it knowing it was the sort of thing that's just a joke.」

259:t_1:115.en:
$$ラルク$$
「Right. $$ニコラ$$ would never do anything that indecent.」

259:t_1:116.en:
$$ノノ$$
「The one who needs to reflect is $$朔哉$$!」

259:t_1:117.en:
$$朔哉$$
「Why does it always have to be me!」

259:t_1:118.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「Sorry, $$朔哉$$. What I said earlier was from an anime I was watching.」

259:t_1:121.en:
$$朔哉$$
「This difference in treatment... What is my existence even... for...」

259:t_2:3.en: ～ $$ドラゴンズハイヴ$$ Command Room ～

259:t_2:6.en:
$$ＷＩＬＬ$$
「We're about 230 light-years back from the point where we met the $$宇宙怪獣$$, toward the center of the galaxy.」

259:t_2:8.en:
$$田中司令$$
「What shall we do? Will you tell everyone about this?」

259:t_2:9.en:
$$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$
「There's no use hiding it. If this is enough to break their spirits, then that is as far as they were going to get.」

259:t_2:10.en:
$$田中司令$$
「In other words, you believe it won't come to that?」

259:t_2:12.en:
$$田中司令$$
「Understood. Then perhaps at dinner.」

259:t_2:17.en:
$$恵子$$
「I never thought it would come to this...」

259:t_2:18.en:
$$宇宙太$$
「No wonder... I'm completely wiped out.」

259:t_2:19.en:
$$勝平$$
「Hey, $$ワッ太$$! Is that god $$ゼウス$$ really on our side!?」

259:t_2:20.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「No doubt about it! We fought together in the $$時獄戦役$$!」

259:t_2:21.en:
$$正太郎$$
「...When we were transferred by $$ゼウス$$'s power, didn't you hear something like a person's voice?」

259:t_2:22.en:
$$さやか$$
「I heard it! A voice like screaming, or crying...」

259:t_2:23.en:
$$ボス$$
「What in the world was that!?」

259:t_2:24.en:
$$ヌケ$$
「I-I don't really know, but somehow it felt good...」

259:t_2:25.en:
$$ムチャ$$
「Y-yeah! Weird thing to say at a time like this, but it was kind of calming...!」

259:t_2:26.en:
$$甲児$$
「But that voice is the cause...」

259:t_2:28.en:
$$甲児$$
「Otherwise, there's no way this could have happened.」

259:t_2:29.en:
$$正太郎$$
「But power strong enough to interfere with $$ゼウス$$, a god...」

259:t_2:31.en:
$$勝平$$
「...Hey... By the way, what's a god?」

259:t_2:32.en:
$$勝平$$
「Those $$ミケーネ$$ guys and $$ゼウス$$ are both a bit different from the image of a god I know, but...」

259:t_2:33.en:
$$恵子$$
「You're right. The $$ミケーネ$$ side especially - far from helping humans, it looks like they were trying to wipe us out.」

259:t_2:34.en:
$$さやか$$
「Your doubts are perfectly reasonable, $$勝平$$ and $$恵子$$. We thought the same thing during the $$時獄戦役$$.」

259:t_2:35.en:
$$タケル$$
「...This is only my own view, but when they say 'god,' I think they mean a being with power beyond humans.」

259:t_2:36.en:
$$タケル$$
「Our notions of justice and evil don't enter into it. Someone with power is simply calling themselves a god.」

259:t_2:37.en:
$$宇宙太$$
「But $$タケル$$... $$ゼウス$$ aside, the $$ミケーネ神$$s are more like devils than gods.」

259:t_2:38.en:
$$タケル$$
「$$ミケーネ$$ said it. That they themselves are gods, and that $$バアル$$ are the true devils.」

259:t_2:39.en:
$$甲児$$
「And that gods and devils are fighting in space, and that human existence is meaningless... so they said.」

259:t_2:41.en:
$$宇宙太$$
「...Maybe so... People like us who need years to get back to Earth must look pretty puny to those guys or the $$宇宙怪獣$$.」

259:t_2:42.en:
$$勝平$$
「Shut up, $$宇宙太$$! We didn't lose to the $$宇宙怪獣$$ or $$ミケーネ$$, did we!」

259:t_2:43.en:
$$恵子$$
「We won today because $$ゼウス$$ helped us too... But tomorrow, who knows what will happen...」

259:t_2:44.en:
$$さやか$$
「We're at a position even closer to the center of the galaxy... If a nest of $$宇宙怪獣$$ lies at the galactic center, same as in $$ノリコ$$'s world...」

259:t_2:45.en:
$$正太郎$$
「I'm sure we'll come under another $$宇宙怪獣$$ attack, won't we...」
